_meta.purpose: ROI-vs-agency comparison data for the demo's Business 30% scene — renders cost bars + labor-saved. Numbers match scripts/demo/submission/BUSINESS-CASE.md §2.4 exactly.
_meta.authority: BUSINESS-CASE.md (Track 3 Business 30%); D28 ($0.01/view price), D39/D46 (cost envelope), D3 (A2A distribution), D12 (multi-tenant).
_meta.honesty_note: agency_cost_usd is the agency MANAGEMENT-FEE line only (creator media spend is identical pass-through in both columns and is excluded from the delta). social_seeding_cost_usd is our GCP compute cost-of-goods (NOT the $0.01/view price, which is revenue). Savings % compares the management layer to machine compute. Agency fees are CITED benchmarks; Social Seeding costs are DERIVED from COST-PLAN.md §2 + committed per-call USD constants. 20x creator fan-out is a labeled assumption. No invented customers/LOIs/signups; design-partner program is open with zero validated signups (pre-launch).
_meta.creator_media_spend_note: 20 creators x $600 (CITED TikTok micro rate $200-$1,500). Identical in both columns; excluded from savings delta.

scenarios.agency_cost_formula: 20% (midpoint of CITED 15-30% of-creator-spend agency model) x $12,000 creator spend
scenarios.social_seeding_cost_formula: $0.62 full loop (COST-PLAN.md §2, Gemini 3.5 Flash) + $6.40 20-creator fan-out + $0.30 capability tool calls (real code constants) + $0.08 amortized infra
scenarios.labor_hours_formula: 45h manual (CITED: 20h find + 10h vet + 15h outreach) -> ~2h human review (AP2 + escalation gates, D27)

scenarios.agency_cost_formula: CITED project-fee floor for a small campaign ($5,000-$50,000); shown as alternate, not headline (we use the lower % model to avoid inflating the delta)
CITED boutique micro-agency retainer $3,000-$8,000/mo covering 3-5 campaigns -> ~$1,500/campaign
CITED full-service retainer $15,000/mo for 10-20 creators, applied as the realistic 50-creator-program fee
scenarios.social_seeding_cost_formula: $0.62 loop + 50 x $0.32 per-creator fan-out + ~$0.50 infra/tool calls
scenarios.labor_hours_formula: CITED 50 x 0.5 FTE-hr + vetting-heavy programs reported at ~100h+ at scale -> ~2h review

unit_economics.price_per_view_basis: D28; $10 effective CPM, within CITED TikTok CPM band $4.8-$13.26
unit_economics.example_views_basis: ASSUMPTION: 20 creators x 50k avg views (conservative micro tier)
unit_economics.gross_margin_note: cost-of-goods margin only; excludes CAC, support, our-side review labor, and creator pay (which is the brand's spend). DERIVED, not net margin.

market_sizing.tam_basis: CITED influencer-marketing PLATFORM/software segment $1.15B (2026), MarketsandMarkets — conservative vs $27.5B-$37.3B total media spend
market_sizing.sam_basis: DERIVED: ~80,000 target brands (ASSUMPTION) x $1,800/yr software ARPM; ~12.5% of platform TAM
market_sizing.som_basis: DERIVED: 3,000 reachable beachhead brands (KR/JP/EN, ASSUMPTION) x 1% capture x ~$18k blended annual = ~$540k ARR
market_sizing.validation_status: pre-launch; zero validated signups; design-partner program open but uncommitted. TAM cited; SAM/SOM brand counts are labeled assumptions (weakest links).
